9.name: Birmingham
9.overview: New series of the house-hunting programme. Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer take on the challenge of finding a house in Birmingham big enough to house three generations of a family - a task made harder when none of them can agree where they want to to live

9.name: Norwich
9.overview: Having already lost three prospective properties in 12 months, two nervous first-time buyers in Norwich need the experts' help more than most. Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer offer their advice, but the couple's contrasting views of what to spend their budget on makes the challenge even harder

9.name: Welsh Borders
9.overview: Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer help a couple find a home in the Welsh borders - a task made harder by their contrasting ambitions. Mel dreams of a rural team-building centre, but his cosmopolitan partner Ali likes their Maidenhead home, which is ideally situated for her job as a long-haul air hostess

9.name: Warwickshire
9.overview: Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer help a family of camel-racers look for a home in Warwickshire. Their current four-bedroomed house is not big enough for their two children and an ever-expanding collection of wild animals, so they need something with more room - preferably eight acres of it

9.name: London
9.overview: Laura Cream leaves the experts struggling to agree with each other as they try to meet her demands for a London property. Her budget of £290,000 must stretch to a two-bedroom ground-floor flat with private parking and room for her paper-marbling business, leaving Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer facing a tough task

9.name: Jersey
9.overview: Young couple Nick and Katrina enlist Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer's help as they try to find a family home on Jersey. Nick is cautious about buying, but when the experts find an unusual property it is left to Katrina to convince her partner that the adventurous option is more worthwhile than the easy one

9.name: Lottery Winners
9.overview: Experts Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer have a generous budget to work with this week when they help lottery winners Lara and Roger Griffiths spend their winnings on a dream home. The couple want a bigger house now they have baby Ruby, but despite their wealth, they cannot agree on how much to spend

9.name: East London
9.overview: Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer help find a property in east London for two childhood friends who hope their investment will be boosted by the 2012 Olympics. Rosie Evatt and Laura Coveney have £220,000 to spend, but the experts soon have to step in to explain their budget will not stretch to exactly what they want

9.name: Dublin
9.overview: Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer help young mother Sue as she looks to move back to Ireland, where she grew up. She wants a home big enough for her husband and two children in Wicklow, south of Dublin, and the family have a generous budget, but they soon realise the challenge they are taking on

9.name: Bristol
9.overview: Experts Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer help first-time buyer Ian Ensum, a clinical psychologist whose uncertainty about the housing market has left him petrified about his first purchase. He has £200,000 to spend, but with plans to work on the house after he has bought it, he is determined to stick to his budget

9.name: Northampton
9.overview: Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer revisit a house they helped first-time buyers Andrew Donald and Ian Salmon find in Northampton a couple of years ago. They discover whether the pair are still glad they went for a terrace house, having originally targeted a newly built property

9.name: East Sussex
9.overview: Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer head for Brighton to revisit a couple they helped a year earlier and discover if their luck improved once the cameras had stopped rolling. The experts had found them the perfect property in Hove, but days after a deal was negotiated the house was taken off the market

9.name: Lincolnshire
9.overview: Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer revisit Lincolnshire couple Darren and Julie Spry who wanted a house with a business attached as they sold up their chip shop and flat. The experts found a teashop and local pub, but both proved too expensive for their tight budget

45.name: Surrey
45.overview: Emily and Jack feel like they've been housefished in Surrey.

45.name: Leeds
45.overview: Emily and Lucy are spoilt for choice near the Leeds hospital where they work.

45.name: South Wales
45.overview: Can South Africans Tish and Ramone find a Cardiff home with high enough ceilings.

45.name: West London
45.overview:
West London (2026)

In pricey west London, will Jody and Shane's million pounds be enough for a slice of Chiswick? And Kirstie gives foodies Roopal and Hershil all the ingredients for an ideal home.

45.name: Hampshire and Berkshire
45.overview: In Berkshire, Phil helps 1980s Olympic skiing sensation Eddie the Eagle and Karen, who've seen 100 houses in 18 months. Kirstie helps Orla and Luke fend off Basingstoke's buyers to bag them 'the one'

45.name: Edinburgh and Derbyshire Revisit
45.overview: We catch up with Steph and Tana in Edinburgh, did they get the family home they were after? In Derbyshire did Wendy and Simon find the picture perfect place they craved?

45.name: London Revisit
45.overview: We're back in The Big Smoke. Have musicians Molly and Sam found harmony and a home? And it's a Crystal Palace catch up with Alan and Rachel, who've left no stone unturned making their home their own.

45.name: Wiltshire & West Midlands Revisit
45.overview: In Wiltshire, we see if Hayley and James' unicorn house is just as magical as the first day they saw it. And after some Solihull soul searching, did Camilla and Liam's car parking compromise pay off?

45.name: Leeds and West London Revisit
45.overview: We catch up with Max who moved from Birmingham to Leeds for love - and it's not just doorbells on the horizon. And 15 years on from their search, a lot's changed for Cat and Ed in London.

46.name: East London
46.overview: In east London, there's negotiation flirtation as Phil finds Abbi an accessible abode, and Kirstie stretches Rhian and Cathal's £500k for 'the one'.

46.name: Cheshire and North Wales
46.overview: Ruth and Ryan work up a sweat as a home sauna hots up their £750k Cheshire search. And will a countryside charmer with vivacious views deliver Peter and Kirsty's Welsh dream?

46.name: Warwickshire
46.overview: In Warwickshire, can Isla and Luke overlook a cemetery to call a new house home? And Jan and Jon are treated to a property plethora of beams, snugs, party-ready gardens and games rooms galore.

46.name: South London
46.overview: In south London, Peter and Kate have an uphill battle to get out of Kate’s rental and start living together. And can Canadian couple Mel and Cody land their perfect pad in their favourite area?

46.name: Berkshire and Hampshire
46.overview: In Berkshire and Hampshire, Sharon gets some tough love to end her five-year search, while Becca and Phill hope to say ‘I do’ to a new home so they can finally engage in their wedding plans.

lastEpisodeToAir.overview: In Berkshire and Hampshire, Sharon gets some tough love to end her five-year search, while Becca and Phill hope to say ‘I do’ to a new home so they can finally engage in their wedding plans.

overview: No floorboard is left unturned as dynamic property experts Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer help house-hunters find the perfect home in the perfect location.
title: Location, Location, Location
